mission: Capture primary research that separately establishes assumptions and limitations for optional stopping and continuation; confidence sequences and test martingales; e-value calibration and valid evidence combination; fixed-family and online false-discovery control under dependence; adaptive selection and repeated holdout reuse; and failures from incompatible filtrations or incorrectly reused data. Preserve formal null classes, stopping-time filtrations, hypothesis-selection timing, dependence conditions, sample populations, actual versus asymptotic guarantees, and negative results. Capture is for later assertion extraction and independent review, not proof of universal validity.
